# @canopy/config

The Canopy config file: defineConfig, env() markers, identity provider presets, and a loader that validates everything at once.

Read variables with `env()`: missing ones are reported together and secrets stay redacted in `canopy config print`.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/config
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { builtin, defineConfig, env } from "@canopy/config"

export default defineConfig({
  mongodb: { uri: env("MONGODB_URI") },
  auth: builtin({ emailPassword: true }),
  keys: { publishable: env.list.optional("CANOPY_PUBLISHABLE_KEYS") },
  policies: { dir: "./policies" },
})
```
